key_insight: Simultaneous cross-helicity transfer uniquely determines pairwise energy and cross-helicity exchanges within nonlinear triads in incompressible MHD turbulence.
engineering_relevance: This result offers a rigorous basis for interpreting energy-transfer pathways in incompressible MHD simulations relevant to conducting-fluid and plasma flows.
method: Analyze conservative nonlinear exchanges among three interacting spatial fluctuations.
Use simultaneous cross-helicity transfer to constrain triad dynamics.
Prove uniqueness of the pair-exchange representation for energy and cross-helicity transfer.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a mathematical uniqueness proof, but no numerical benchmarks, experimental data, or AI-based evaluation.
watch_item: The result is established for incompressible MHD; applicability to compressible flows or Navier–Stokes turbulence is not demonstrated in the abstract.
